# Credits

Orbkit ships two kinds of orb. Every file says which it is.

## Shaders by XorDev

These 19 orbs are ported from golfed shaders by [XorDev](https://x.com/XorDev),
used with his permission (agreed by direct message on 2026-09-06). Terms:
**non-commercial use only, with attribution to XorDev**. Each file starts with
a notice that must stay with any copy, and the registry marks these items with
a `credit` field. See [LICENSE-SHADERS.md](LICENSE-SHADERS.md).

## Original orbs

These 14 orbs are Orbkit's own work and are MIT-licensed, like the runtime:
shdr-11, shdr-12, shdr-13, shdr-14, shdr-16, shdr-17, shdr-21, shdr-23, shdr-24, shdr-27, shdr-29, shdr-30, shdr-32, shdr-33.

## Adding shaders

Ask the original author before porting anything that is not your own. XorDev
asked to be consulted before any more of his work is included.
